faq.q: Is the German A1 course in Dehradun suitable for complete beginners?
faq.a: Yes. The German A1 course assumes no previous knowledge. We start with the alphabet, pronunciation and everyday phrases, and build up to simple conversations about yourself and daily life.

faq.q: What does the Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1 exam test?
faq.a: The Goethe A1 exam tests reading, listening, writing and speaking at a basic level: short notices, simple announcements, filling in a form and introducing yourself. We practise each part in class and in mock tests.

faq.q: Is A1 German enough for a spouse or family reunion visa?
faq.a: Many family reunion visa applications for Germany ask for basic German, commonly at A1 level. Requirements can change and have exceptions, so always confirm the current rule with the German embassy or consulate before you apply.

faq.q: Can I learn German A1 online from Dehradun?
faq.a: Yes. Our German A1 classes run online and offline at the Race Course centre in Dehradun, with morning, evening and personalised batches.

faq.q: When can I move from A1 to A2?
faq.a: Once you are comfortable with A1 tasks and your trainer confirms your level, you can join the next German A2 batch. A counsellor can share the upcoming A2 batch dates in Dehradun.
